created_files.description: Ternary physical structural mask (ALLOWED='1', DISALLOWED='0', UNKNOWN='?'), register loader, schema validation, project-relative path resolution, unexcited actuator tracking.
29 focused unit tests covering loading, validation, duplicate/conflicting record detection, ternary gate semantics, gate ordering, unexcited actuators, CRI uncertainty, and determinism.
Structural mask and gate configuration, input register SHA-256 hash, breakdown metrics, policy parameters, and unexcited actuator specification.
Full verbose pytest trace showing 29 focused tests passing and all 865 unit/integration tests passing.
Manifest of created, modified, and preserved files.
Comprehensive engineering and scientific report for the G0_STRUCTURAL_MASK milestone.

modified_files.changes: Exported PhysicalStructuralMask, StructuralStatus, PhysicalConnectivityRecord, StructuralMaskConfig, and gate_structural_mask.
Integrated Gate G0_STRUCTURAL_MASK before G1_DELAY_FEASIBILITY, added structural_mask and allow_unknown to GatingConfig, preserved structural_mask_status in observation audit trail.
Added structural_mask_status to PropagationObservation, added UNEXCITED_PRIOR to EdgeState, added unexcited metadata to EdgeRecord, added cri_status and unexcited_sources to CRIRecord.
Integrated EdgeState.UNEXCITED_PRIOR transitions into EdgeLifecycleStateMachine (persists on silence, promotes to CANDIDATE upon fresh evidence).
Added optional structural_mask support to PathFinderConfig and defense-in-depth pruning of prohibited edges during DFS.
Integrated unexcited actuator tracking and structural mask awareness into CRIConfig and CRICalculator; flags cri_status='UNCERTAIN_UNEXCITED' when upstream physical predecessors were unexcited.
